description: Replace an always-allow stub with a token bucket that refills fractionally over elapsed time and caps at capacity
prompts: src/lib.rs's TokenBucket::allow always returns true. Implement it properly: TokenBucket::new(capacity: f64, refill_rate: f64) - `refill_rate` tokens are added per second, capped at `capacity` tokens (never above it, even after a long idle period). allow(&mut self, now: f64) -> bool refills the bucket based on elapsed seconds since the last call, then - if at least 1 token is available - consumes exactly 1 token and returns true; otherwise returns false and consumes nothing. The bucket starts full at construction time.
name: add_rust_token_bucket_limiter
